t: The Infinity Trident is a tool that allows you to release the true power of a Trident. Increasing the tier will give you access to different levels of $(6)Loyalty$(), $(6)Riptide$() and $(6)Channeling$(). $(br2)Channeling and hit damage will be applied in aoe.
无限三叉戟是一种能让你释放三叉戟真正力量的工具。提升等级可让你获得不同等级的 $(6)忠诚$()、$(6)激流$() 和 $(6)引雷$()。$(br2)引雷效果和命中伤害都会以范围形式生效。
